audit.whatIsWrong: 'Null Sphere's silence' is the stated reason Kassadin wins level 1, in spikes[0].text, early and whys[0]. Null Sphere has no silence.
audit.why: The chart's only Kassadin-favoured early row rests entirely on an ability effect that does not exist. Riot's text for Null Sphere is damage, a channel interrupt and a shield absorbing magic damage. A player who steps up at level 1 expecting to lock Yi's answer out gets Alpha-Struck instead.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real level-1 edge, which is range and cooldown: Null Sphere reaches 650 against Alpha Strike's 600, and returns in 9 seconds against his 20.

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is a channel and Null Sphere interrupts channels. Nothing on the page says so.
audit.why: This is the single most valuable button Kassadin owns in this lane and it is free. Meditate is a flat 10s heal-and-damage-reduction channel; a 650-range Q on a 9s cooldown cancels it essentially every time. The page instead tells the player his early Q is for a silence that does not exist, and never mentions the interrupt that does.
audit.corrected: Written into content.mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1] and whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late's plan is 'you kite, he cannot catch'. Highlander makes Master Yi immune to all slowing effects, so Force Pulse — Kassadin's only kiting tool — does nothing for its whole duration.
audit.why: The advice names the right outcome for the wrong reason, and the wrong reason will get a player killed: he will throw the cone expecting to peel and find Yi at full speed on top of him. What actually out-paces Highlander is Riftwalk's blinks, not the slow.
audit.corrected: Stated in content.late, spikes[3].text, whys[4] and whys[6] — blink, do not kite.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup for having NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and that is accurate — not one number appears in the entire entry.
audit.why: Every decision in this lane keys off three numbers: Alpha Strike at 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s but shortened by his basic attacks, Meditate at a flat 10s, and Highlander at 85s. Without them 'only blink onto him after his Alpha Strike is down' is a mood, not an instruction.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike's 20s and its attack-based reduction added to content.late; Meditate's 10s to content.mid; Null Sphere's 9s versus Alpha Strike's 20s to spikes[0], early and whys[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither Void Stone nor Null Sphere's shield is mentioned, and both are dead in this matchup — Yi's damage is physical and true.
audit.why: Kassadin's whole defensive identity is magic mitigation. Against Wuju Style true damage and Alpha Strike physical, he has none of it, which is the real reason levels 3-5 are unsurvivable rather than merely bad.

The difficulty shape as charted — Kassadin level 1, even at 2, Yi from 3 through first item, Kassadin at two-plus items — matches a 46.91% win rate over 194 games and matches the kit: Yi's power is Wuju Style plus an item spike, Kassadin's is stacked Riftwalk. No elo-tier language present. Left alone apart from correcting the stated reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows name stages but not what creates them — 'his spike lands long before yours' with no mechanism.
audit.why: Yi's mid-lane spike is not only items; Meditate on a 10-second cooldown means he refunds the chip Kassadin manages to land, which is why the gap widens rather than holds.
audit.corrected: Meditate named as part of the spike in spikes[2].text and whys[3].

All my edits here are content-layer only for that reason. The 'kassadin' self-entry looks like the collision that displaced it. CHAMPION-WIDE, VERIFIED ON THE WIKI: Void Stone is 10% magic damage reduction, not the 15% written across these pages (reduced in V11.24); and Force Pulse has not been charge-gated since V12.23 — it is a 21/20/19/18/17s cooldown that ability casts within 1800 units shorten by one second each. The kit file still carries Riot's pre-rework tooltip text, which is why the 'E only charges when spells fly' boilerplate persists on every other Kassadin matchup. THE SILENCE IS THE HEADLINE HERE: this page does not merely mention a silence in passing, it uses it as the sole justification for the one early stage the chart awards Kassadin. _missing-interactions.json also carries an unusable entry for this matchup ('Master Yi sustains through chip damage (Meditate)') that misses the far more important fact that Meditate is a channel Null Sphere cancels outright.
